title: ISO/RFC 8-Bit S-box Circuits (Whirlpool, ARIA S2 & InvS2): Total Gates, AND Gates & AND-Depth
description: Nine pure Lean 4.36.0 (zero Mathlib) certified Boolean-circuit hill-climb tracks minimizing total gates, multiplicative complexity (AND gates), and multiplicative depth (AND-depth for masked/MPC/FHE implementations) for Whirlpool (ISO/IEC 10118-3) and ARIA S2 / InvS2 (RFC 5794 / ISO 18033-3), pinned verbatim to `openssl/openssl@d94024ff` (Apache-2.0).

tasks.title: Whirlpool (8-bit S-box): minimize total gate count over {xor, xnor, and, not} (baseline 202)
tasks.description: Minimize total gate count over {xor, xnor, and, not} for the Whirlpool 8-bit S-box (baseline 202, open frontier: ~100-120). Submit a straight-line Boolean circuit in `StdSbox/WhirlpoolTotalCircuit.lean` (`StdSbox.whirlpoolTotalScore`, `StdSbox.whirlpoolTotalGates`, `StdSbox.whirlpoolTotalOutputs`). Frozen pure Lean 4.36.0 kernel proofs verify well-formedness, cost metric, and exact equivalence on all 256 bytes.
